subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that can substitute the bracketed word segment correctly and complete the sentence meaningfully.

We will have to (put the meeting away) as the Director is not well.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. put the meeting off.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"put off" **means to postpone or delay an event or meeting.
 
• In the given sentence, the Director is not well, so the meeting needs to be postponed.
 
• The other options do not convey the correct meaning:
 
 
• "Put the meeting up" does not make sense in the context of postponing.
 
• "Put the meeting on" suggests scheduling or starting the meeting, not postponing it.
 
• "Put the meeting again" is not a grammatically correct phrase.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
